QUOTE: The text before the first `:` is an fnmatch glob matched against the fully-qualified tool name, e.g. `filesystem.*` or `git.commit`. No colon means a tool-only match.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, splitting at the first colon into a tool part and an argument part (tool:arg), and that no colon means a tool-name-only match.
